responses.subject: Re: 🇨🇳 China's MiniMax crushes Opus 4.6
responses.body:
Dear Simplifying AI,

Thank you for sharing this update on MiniMax's M2.5 coding model. The competitive pricing and performance metrics you've highlighted are particularly noteworthy, especially the 20× cost reduction compared to frontier models while maintaining comparable capabilities to Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.2.

We appreciate receiving your AI newsletter and will review the additional content you've mentioned, including the OpenAI Codex-Spark launch and Gemini 3 Deep Think benchmarks.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment is appropriate for this informational newsletter. The response confirms receipt while briefly commenting on the key highlights, maintaining a business-appropriate tone.
